text:
maria: Heads up — I'm trying to model tiered routing + soft quotas in the console. the current policy schema feels awkward for per-tier+region fallbacks. quick brain dump, want opinions.
kevin: paste the schema you're testing?
maria: ```json
{
  "policy_name": "tiered-routing-v1",
  "tiers": {
    "free": {
      "preferred_variant": "open-7b",
      "fallback_variant": "open-3b",
      "quota_mode": "soft",
      "soft_grace_sec": 30
    },
    "pro": {
      "preferred_variant": "redwood-70b",
      "fallback_variant": "redwood-13b-quant",
      "quota_mode": "hard"
    }
  },
  "region_overrides": {
    "eu": { "pro": { "preferred_variant": "redwood-70b-eu" } }
  }
}
```
jordan: Console UX note — users won't read raw JSON. we should show an "effective policy" view per-tenant (tier + region) that flattens overrides.
sam: API semantics question: when soft quota triggers, do we 200 with warning header or 429 and let routing fallback?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: policy-service v2 deployed to staging at 1729004578 :rocket:
liz: prefer explicit modes: `soft` => route to fallback but return 200 with `x-redwood-quota-warning: true` and emit metric `quota.fallback` with tags `{tier,region,reason}`. `hard` => reject/429. also emit `fallback.latency.delta`.
kevin: Agree. also add a `penalty_score` field per-tenant so fairshare and backoff can be tunable.
maria: @liz good — telemetry is key. we should capture `policy_path` (e.g., preferred->fallback) and `variant_pair` in logs so we can run regressions on output quality vs cost.
jordan: Console idea: show a small timeline per-tenant of recent fallback events and cost delta if they had stayed on preferred variant. quick visual for sales/CS.
sam: small API tweak: add `X-Redwood-Policy-Sim: true` header so the console can simulate routing decisions without consuming quota.
maria: I'll open a PR for the header + a lightweight simulator endpoint on policy-service. link once up.
kevin: add e2e that asserts `quota.fallback` metric emitted and `x-redwood-quota-warning` appears for soft mode.
jordan: also default free tier to aggressive fallback (3x) and schedule automated email after 5 fallback events in 24h. ops should be able to opt-out.
maria: noted. I'll prototype the console UI with flattened policy view + simulator button. will schedule a 15m sync after standup to align API + telemetry fields.
kevin: :+1:
liz: :thumbsup: thanks.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/policy-service/pull/4321 — comments welcome.
sam: quick nit — make sure simulator uses anonymized request payloads when sent to telemetry to avoid PII.
maria: yes, will add scrubber.
kevin: sounds good. closing loop after the sync.
